An '''asteroid belt''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. [[Jaden Korr]] believed the belt to be the remains of a structure, possibly a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], destroyed when the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] turned the [[UR-6572-AK system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]] into a [[Unidentified pulsar|pulsar]].
